throughline.zh: 緯創與廣達發布伺服器產能和財務進展，台灣精密測試設備廠公布 CPO 進度，並新增日本資料中心、泰國材料工廠與記憶體採購預測消息。
throughline.en: Wistron and Quanta disclosed server factory and financial developments, precision test suppliers updated CPO progress, and Japanese data-center, Thai materials factory and memory procurement announcements added new regional evidence.

title.zh: 晶圓、封裝測試、設備與科技園區投資
title.en: Wafers, packaging/test, equipment and science-park investment

summary.zh: 本週晶圓代工、封測、測試與材料業者陸續公布營收、工程進度及新計畫。11 月 11 日大銀微系統報告 CPO 定位平台已出貨，旺矽揭露探針卡與光學測試進展，國科會核准園區投資案並預告高階載板技術清單修正，實際出貨、核准資本與草案規範須依各事件分開閱讀。
summary.en: Foundry, packaging, testing and materials companies reported sales and project developments. On November 11 HIWIN MIKROSYSTEM disclosed CPO platform shipments, WinWay described probe-card and optical testing progress, and NSTC approved park projects while proposing substrate technology-list changes. Actual output, investment approvals and draft rules remain distinct.

title.zh: 機櫃電源、精密機械與跨境材料廠投資
title.en: Rack power, precision machinery and overseas materials investment

summary.zh: 中鋼、奇鋐、台達電、光寶科與國巨各自公布工業電力、散熱和零組件資訊，機械公會亦發布工具機與關鍵零組件出口額。11 月 11 日美琪瑪另核准泰國廠房支出及子公司增資，兩項資金決議可能涉及同一工程，無法直接合併為不同設備採購。
summary.en: China Steel, AVC, Delta, Lite-On and Yageo reported site power, cooling or components activity alongside machinery export data. On November 11 Mechema approved a Thai factory budget and subsidiary capitalization, potentially supporting the same project and not establishing separate equipment orders.

title.zh: 資料中心建設與伺服器 ODM 產能安排
title.en: Data-center projects and server ODM capacity

summary.zh: 馬來西亞與印尼機房工程、供水議題仍有各自的合約或因果限制，華碩、英業達與和碩公布伺服器相關營收。11 月 11 日緯創新增台灣及墨西哥產能預算、廣達終止友達華亞廠收購並調整方案，東元則宣布日本首期 6.4MW 模組化機房工程計畫，投資核准與實際上電驗收分屬不同狀態。
summary.en: Malaysian and Indonesian data-center projects retain unresolved contract and water issues, while ASUS, Inventec and Pegatron reported server-related sales. On November 11 Wistron approved Taiwan/Mexico capex, Quanta canceled a planned AUO acquisition and TECO announced a Japanese 6.4MW modular facility. Approved budgets, plans and commissioned loads are distinct.

title.zh: 記憶體技術、成本與 PC 採購預測
title.en: Memory technology, costs and PC procurement outlook

summary.zh: 台積電回應尚未證實的 3D DRAM 報導，華邦電重述已核准的擴產預算，來頡則說明成熟晶圓與封測成本預期。TrendForce 11 月 11 日預估第四季 PC DRAM 合約價季增 13% 至 18%，Client SSD 漲幅低於 5%，數值屬研究機構預測，尚未代表特定廠商實際成交價。
summary.en: TSMC addressed an unconfirmed 3D DRAM report, Winbond restated existing approved fab capex and M3 discussed mature-node costs. TrendForce on November 11 forecast 13%–18% Q4 PC DRAM price growth and under 5% client SSD growth, neither of which establishes individual suppliers' executed contracts.

title.zh: electronica 與 SEMICON Europa 臺灣展商
title.en: Taiwanese exhibitors at electronica and SEMICON Europa

summary.zh: electronica 與 SEMICON Europa 於 11 月 10 至 13 日在慕尼黑舉行，外貿協會公開超過 250 家臺灣參展業者與臺灣館活動資訊。展商參與已有主辦單位資料，仍無可核對的現場採購或成交金額。
summary.en: electronica and SEMICON Europa run November 10–13 in Munich, with TAITRA listing more than 250 Taiwanese exhibitors and a Taiwan pavilion program. Participation is documented; individual contract values have not been established.
